scope.description: Software vendors that compete with zvoove's staffing brands for agency ERP, ATS/CRM, workforce management, payroll and VMS budgets in zvoove's markets (DACH, Benelux, UK, France, Spain).
scope.inclusionLogic: Included: global staffing-software leaders present in Europe, regional staffing ERPs and payroll providers named in German and Dutch market overviews, and VMS vendors competing with DirectSkills. Excluded: generic HR suites without staffing-specific pay and bill, and staffing companies themselves. zvoove's own acquired brands (e.g. ProSolution WorkExpert, Landwehr L1) are not listed as competitors.
scope.notes: Company-reported figures carry each company's own scope (global customers, platform users, agencies). They are not comparable to zvoove's group-level figures (6,500+ customers on zvoove.com; 9,000+ in the May 2026 profitask release; 3 million+ workers; EUR 24 billion payroll volume).
